alt: 公園小徑上，前方孩子高抬腿並摸著帽沿，後面的三個孩子盯著他，連步伐和手勢都跟著照做。
scene_prompt: On a park path three present-day children follow a fourth child in a close line. The leading child takes an unnecessarily exaggerated high step while touching the brim of their hat with the right hand; all three followers mimic precisely the same unusual step and right-hand hat gesture, watching the leader rather than their own path. Show variation in clothing and faces but unmistakably copied actions. The leader's ordinary cap is repeated on followers, no performance stage, no dance lesson or sports drill. Natural anatomy, each person exactly two arms and two legs, generous spacing between silhouettes.
